webhooks_create_description: PP sends a signed POST to this URL when a subscribed event happens.
webhooks_delete_confirm: Delete this webhook and its delivery log?
webhooks_delete_description: Stops all deliveries and removes the delivery log.
webhooks_deliveries_description: The latest deliveries to this URL, newest first.
webhooks_description: Send signed events to other tools when tickets and sprints change.
webhooks_disabled_gone: Disabled: the URL kept answering 404 or 410
webhooks_empty_hint: Add one to wake an agent, notify another tool, or start a job when something changes.
webhooks_error_header_duplicate: Each header can only be set once.
webhooks_error_header_reserved: That header is set by ProjectProject and can't be overridden.
webhooks_error_too_large: This delivery is over 1 MiB and can't be sent.
webhooks_error_too_old: Deliveries older than a day can't be retried.
webhooks_error_url_blocked: That URL points at a private or internal address.
webhooks_error_url_credentials: Remove the username and password from the URL; use a header instead.
webhooks_headers_hint: Sent with every request, for receivers that want a token. Stored encrypted.
webhooks_headers_replace_hint: Values are never shown again, so enter them all. Saving replaces every header.
webhooks_list_description: Each webhook receives the events it subscribes to, signed with its own secret.
webhooks_secret_reveal_description: Copy it into your receiver now. It won't be shown again; rotate it if it's lost.
webhooks_secret_rotate_confirm: The current secret stops working immediately.
webhooks_status_retrying: Failing, {count} in a row. Next attempt {when}
webhooks_url_hint: An https URL. It's stored encrypted and afterwards only its host is shown.
webhooks_url_required: Enter the URL to send events to.
